color.theme.faint: Faintest theme tint. USE for subtle backgrounds and hover states.
color.theme.weaker: Very light theme tint. USE for secondary backgrounds and disabled states.
color.theme.weak: Light theme tint. USE for borders and light accent backgrounds.
color.theme.mid: Mid-range theme color. USE for secondary buttons and active states.
color.theme.default: Primary theme color. USE for primary buttons, links, and key UI accents.
color.theme.strong: Dark theme variant. USE for hover states on primary elements.
color.theme.stronger: Darkest theme variant. USE for active/pressed states on primary elements.
applied.color.accent: Accent color for highlights and emphasis. USE sparingly for visual interest.
applied.color.base.default: Default base color for UI elements. USE for borders and dividers.
applied.color.base.weak: Subtle base color. USE for hover states and subtle backgrounds.
applied.color.success.default: Success state indicator. USE for confirmations and positive feedback. MUST pair with success icon.
applied.color.success.strong: Strong success emphasis. USE for success text on light backgrounds.
applied.color.success.weak: Success background tint. USE for success alert backgrounds.
applied.color.info.default: Informational state. USE for neutral notifications and tips.
applied.color.info.strong: Strong info emphasis. USE for info text on light backgrounds.
applied.color.info.weak: Info background tint. USE for info alert backgrounds.
applied.color.warning.default: Warning state. USE for cautions that need attention. SHOULD pair with warning icon.
applied.color.warning.strong: Strong warning emphasis. USE for warning text on light backgrounds.
applied.color.warning.weak: Warning background tint. USE for warning alert backgrounds.
applied.color.danger.default: Danger/error state. USE for errors and destructive actions. MUST pair with error message.
applied.color.danger.strong: Strong danger emphasis. USE for error text on light backgrounds.
applied.color.danger.weak: Danger background tint. USE for error alert backgrounds.
applied.color.emergency.default: Emergency banner color. USE only for critical system-wide alerts.
applied.color.emergency.weak: Emergency accent. USE for emergency banner highlights.
applied.color.ink.default: Primary ink color. USE for icons and graphic elements.
applied.color.ink.reverse: Reverse ink for dark backgrounds. USE for icons on dark surfaces.
applied.color.text.default: Primary text color. USE for body copy and headings. MUST meet WCAG 4.5:1 contrast.
applied.color.text.weak: Secondary text. USE for metadata, captions, and supporting content.
applied.color.text.weaker: Tertiary text. USE for placeholder text and subtle labels. AVOID for important content.
applied.color.text.weakest: Decorative text only. AVOID for readable content - insufficient contrast.
applied.color.text.disabled: Disabled text state. USE only for disabled form elements.
applied.color.text.reverse: Primary text on dark backgrounds. MUST use with surface-reverse.
applied.color.text.reverse-weak: Secondary text on dark backgrounds. USE for metadata on dark surfaces.
applied.color.text.reverse-weaker: Tertiary text on dark backgrounds. USE for subtle content on dark surfaces.
applied.color.text.reverse-disabled: Disabled text on dark backgrounds. USE only for disabled elements on dark surfaces.
applied.color.link.default: Default link color. MUST be distinguishable from body text. USE for inline links.
applied.color.link.strong: Visited or hover link state. USE for :visited and :hover states.
applied.color.link.strongest: Active link state. USE for :active state on links.
applied.color.link.neutral: Neutral link style. USE when link styling should match body text color.
applied.color.link.reverse: Link on dark background. USE for links on dark surfaces.
applied.color.link.reverse-strong: Hover link on dark background. USE for :hover on dark surfaces.
applied.color.link.reverse-strongest: Active link on dark background. USE for :active on dark surfaces.
applied.color.link.reverse-neutral: Neutral link on dark background. USE for neutral links on dark surfaces.
applied.color.surface.default: Default page background. USE for main content areas and cards.
applied.color.surface.reverse: Dark surface background. USE for dark mode sections and footers.
applied.color.surface.raised: Elevated surface background. USE for cards and raised elements.
applied.color.focus: Focus ring color. MUST be visible on all backgrounds. USE for :focus-visible outlines.
applied.color.focus-reverse: Focus ring color on dark backgrounds. USE for :focus-visible outlines on dark surfaces.
font.family.agency: Agency branding font family. USE for agency-specific branded text elements.
font.family.body: Body text font family. USE for paragraphs and running text. PREFER over --nys-font-family-sans.
font.family.display: Display font family. USE for hero text and large decorative headings. PREFER over --nys-font-family-sans.
font.family.ui: UI font family. USE for buttons, labels, and form elements. PREFER over --nys-font-family-sans.
font.family.heading: Heading font family. USE for h1–h6 headings. PREFER over --nys-font-family-sans.
font.size.body-xs: Body text size (extra-small). USE for captions and fine print.
font.size.body-sm: Body text size (small). USE for secondary text and metadata.
font.size.body-md: Body text size (medium). USE for default paragraph and running text.
font.size.body-lg: Body text size (large). USE for lead paragraphs and emphasized body text.
font.size.h1: Heading 1 size. USE for primary page headings.
font.size.h2: Heading 2 size. USE for section headings.
font.size.h3: Heading 3 size. USE for subsection headings.
font.size.h4: Heading 4 size. USE for minor headings.
font.size.h5: Heading 5 size. USE for minor headings.
font.size.h6: Heading 6 size. USE for minor headings.
font.size.ui-xs: UI element size (extra-small). USE for small labels and badges.
font.size.ui-sm: UI element size (small). USE for compact buttons and form controls.
font.size.ui-md: UI element size (medium). USE for default buttons, labels, and form controls.
font.size.ui-lg: UI element size (large). USE for prominent buttons and form controls.
font.size.ui-xl: UI element size (extra-large). USE for large interactive elements.
font.size.display-sm: Display text size (small). USE for hero banners and decorative headings.
font.size.display-md: Display text size (medium). USE for hero banners and decorative headings.
font.size.display-lg: Display text size (large). USE for hero banners and decorative headings.
font.size.display-xl: Display text size (extra-large). USE for hero banners and decorative headings.
font.size.agency-md: Agency branding text size (medium). USE for agency-specific branded elements.
font.size.agency-lg: Agency branding text size (large). USE for agency-specific branded elements.
font.size.agency-xl: Agency branding text size (extra-large). USE for agency-specific branded elements.
